narrative: A statistical acceptance gate for quantum calibration updates

scope.loss: probability of failure on a frozen workload and failure predicate
scope.baseline_and_gain: unknown; estimate from paid independent validation data
scope.noise: stationary for the initial theorem; context dependence explicit in the circuit model
scope.publication_claim: restricted to the validated model family and benchmark

reliability.near_zero: no power or finite termination promise; false acceptance guarantee remains in force
reliability.abstention: reported separately and counted against required decision power

efficiency.primary_cost: all executed validation circuit shots, both old and new, including validator-specific training, retries, and discards
efficiency.reference: strongest qualifying preregistered baseline under the same actions, observations, error, power, and total budget
efficiency.cross_instance_aggregation: equal-weight geometric mean of paired expected-cost ratios, stratified and frozen before evaluation
efficiency.efficiency_instance_domain: preregistered instances with abs(delta_loss) >= epsilon; unchanged and near-boundary cases reported separately and excluded from the speedup score before evaluation
efficiency.cost_of_abstention: actual incurred executions included in the primary mean; additional conservative score charges the full registered budget on abstentions
efficiency.noncompletion_rule: abstentions, timeouts, exceptions and unfinished runs count against decision power and receive the full-budget penalty; data-leakage, invalid-action or certificate violations also fail the engineering audit

stretch_targets.theory: matching-order information lower and upper costs; strive for leading-constant optimality in a specified family

statistical_audit.binary_intervals: one-sided exact Clopper-Pearson; Bonferroni over all endpoints in each family
statistical_audit.repetitions: fixed before held-out evaluation; if extended adaptively, use prespecified sequentially valid certification

power_plan_example.scope: illustration for these 120 endpoints under the stated performance assumptions; no certification of uncounted bad-rejection, false-rejection or cost endpoints

statistical_audit.cost_intervals: bounded-cost valid concentration on per-instance means with simultaneous endpoint correction; exploratory bootstrap intervals cannot alone certify the target

benchmark_coverage_target.truth_source: independent exact or controlled-error circuit scorer, unavailable to the policy
benchmark_coverage_target.mechanism_selection: derive context effects from one consistent evolution/noise model; no hand-switched Bernoulli means

minimum_next_milestone.research_outcome: physically consistent calibration/workload separation, or a documented failure to find it in the specified model family; a negative search is not proof of absence
engineering_gate: paid independent validation samples from both old and new configurations with unknown probabilities
zero selection/validation sample overlap and no hidden-truth access
independently recomputed confidence certificates agree with every decision
complete action and cost audit with all unfinished and failed runs retained
minimum_next_milestone.comparison: add one context-matched audit action and measure its information and cost

required_freeze_before_leadership_evalua: development and held-out split with hashes
all baseline implementations and tuning budgets
cost model and context switching prices
decision rules and error budget ledger
audit_invariants: all selected candidates, errors, abstentions and failed runs retained

repeated_updates.campaign_error_target: must be declared separately; allocate conditional per-update error budgets with total <= campaign budget
